rationale: Without a KYC profile there is no legal name, so the sanctions tool is never called and no list entry is returned. Read literally, ADR 019 still creates the gap for an open sanctions alert without a returned entry. There is no concern; missing KYC and the gap both point to request_information.

context.description: Open sanctions alert for a customer without a KYC profile. Entirely fictional evaluation case.

expected.summary: No profile means no search; the open alert remains unresolved.

signals.statement: An open sanctions alert has no returned list match. An empty tool response does not resolve the alert; obtain identification evidence for human review.
